subject: Seraphine Voss declared a heretic and a traitor to the Imperium of man
senderName: Inquisitor Vontis Mortis of the Ordos Hereticus
message:
BY DECREE OF THE HOLY INQUISITION
UNDER THE AUTHORITY OF THE ORDO HERETICUS
LET THIS NOTICE BE PROCLAIMED IN ALL IMPERIAL PORTS, HALLS OF RECORD,
MERCANTILE HOUSES, VOID-DOCKS, AND DOMAINS WHERE THE NAME OF VOSS IS KNOWN

To all scions, bastards, widows, cousins, retainers, and blood-descended claimants of the Voss line,
wherever within the God-Emperor's Imperium they may dwell:

Hear now the judgment of the Holy Ordos.

Lady Seraphine Voss, once entrusted with the sacred authority of a Rogue Trader and bearer of a Warrant of Trade under the sanction of the Imperium, has been declared traitor, apostate, and heretic. By sealed testimony, witness account, and evidence gathered under the authority of the Ordo Hereticus, she stands accused of acts so profane, forbidden, and grievous in their nature that their full record remains sealed from public account by command of the Inquisition.

She has fled the Emperor's justice.
She has abandoned her oaths.
She has corrupted the honor of her bloodline.
She has stained the name of Voss before the Throne of Terra.

Therefore, by command of the Holy Inquisition, all surviving blood of House Voss are hereby summoned to answer.

Let it be known plainly and without dispute:
Whosoever among the Voss line delivers Seraphine Voss to judgment, or brings before the Inquisition irrefutable proof of her death, shall be recognized as the foremost claimant to the Voss Warrant of Trade, subject only to the final judgment and confirmation of the Holy Inquisition and the lawful authorities of the Imperium.

No branch shall be excluded.
No distant kin shall be denied hearing.
No bastard line, collateral heir, or forgotten descendant shall be dismissed if their claim is proven in blood, deed, and loyalty.

The right of inheritance shall belong not merely to birth, but to service.
The future of the Voss name shall be decided by the fall of Seraphine Voss.

For this reason, all those of Voss blood are commanded to turn their gaze toward the world of Nebryss, for it is there that the fugitive now hides.

Know the nature of the world to which you are summoned.

Nebryss lies at the far edge of the Imperium Nihilus, a vast ocean world broken into scattered islands, drifting strongholds, hidden coves, and unstable aerial and maritime routes. It is a realm where local powers contend endlessly for trade, territory, and survival, where merchants and warlords speak in the same tongues of profit and violence, and where Imperial authority endures only through vigilance, force, and faith.

Its greatest peril is the mist.

The mist of Nebryss is no natural weather, but a baleful and shifting veil that hangs above the waters and between the islands. It obscures routes, deceives navigators, distorts instruments, and turns safe passage into sudden death. Ships vanish within it. Crews are lost to madness, wreck, or creatures born of its depths. Stable trade lanes are rare and precious, and every voyage upon Nebryss is made at hazard of life, vessel, and soul.

Yet among this danger stands Zephyria, the grand floating island-ship and mercantile crown of the Gilded Accord. It is a place of wealth, traffic, bargaining, rumor, and veiled ambition. Its bazaars teem with traders and free captains. Its drydocks furnish ships fit to brave the mist-lanes. Its taverns and counting houses are thick with whispers, contracts, and concealed loyalties. There, amid noise and commerce, truth is bought dearly and betrayal is often sold cheap.

It is in this world, amid these islands, trade routes, and mist-shrouded waters, that Seraphine Voss seeks refuge.

Let none offer it to her.

To harbor Seraphine Voss is treason.
To supply her is treason.
To bargain with her is treason.
To conceal knowledge of her movements is treason.
To obstruct those who answer this summons is to share in her guilt and to invite the full wrath of the Ordo Hereticus.

Therefore, all Voss claimants are commanded:
Come to Nebryss.
Seek the fugitive.
Gather intelligence on her vessels, allies, hidden ports, and storehouses.
Pursue her across every lawful route and every shadowed harbor.
And when she is found, see that she is brought to final judgment.

Let this decree be carried from world to world.
Let it be nailed to void-port gates and spoken in noble halls.
Let it be heard by every soul who bears the blood or banner of Voss.

The hunt has begun.
Nebryss is the appointed ground.
Zephyria is among its gates.
The mist shall not protect the condemned forever.
And from the ruin of one heretic, a new bearer of the Warrant shall rise.

By His Will, let the impure be cast down.
By His Light, let the stain be burned away.
By command of the Holy Inquisition, Ordo Hereticus,
let Seraphine Voss be found, judged, and ended.

Seal of the Holy Inquisition
Ordo Hereticus
To be posted and proclaimed in all compliant Imperial territories
